TANIT HORIZON - WHERE HEART MEETS SPACE
TANIT HORIZON is an innovative startup committed to develop advanced technological solutions for agriculture in extreme environments, both terrestrial and extraterrestrial.The company focuses on the research, development, production, and marketing of automated cultivation systems—hydroponic and aeroponic—integrated with technical substrates and technologies adaptable to critical or non-terrestrial climates, including the lunar, Martian, and other space environments.
Our vision stems from a dual challenge: enabling life in Space and improving the quality of life on Earth.Our systems are designed to support life on long-duration space missions, making a tangible contribution to astronauts' food self-sufficiency. At the same time, we bring these innovations to Earth, offering sustainable solutions for agricultural production in dense urban areas, desert regions, or climate-stressed areas.
Technology and sustainability merge in an intelligent system that integrates Internet of Things (IoT) sensors, Artificial Intelligence (AI), and LED lighting to monitor and adjust optimal growth conditions in real time, improving plant physiological development and optimizing water, nutrient, and energy consumption.
TANIT HORIZON represents a unique convergence of space research, agricultural innovation and environmental sustainability, with significant scientific, social, and humanitarian implications. We are helping to shape a future where food can be grown anywhere—from the International Space Station to our planet's urban centers—efficiently, resiliently, and resource-efficiently.

ESA benefits from a new and concrete application area for Earth observation and satellite connectivity: snow storage as a climate resilience tool. entityDescription:
CAELUS is an Italian deep tech startup established in October 2023 by current CEO Alessio Iuvara that has set itself the goal of reducing the costs and time of designing, licensing, building and decommissioning nuclear reactors through its unified AI-based software suite. Specifically, the designed product is an enterprise software suite that employs a series of innovative advanced technologies such as AI/ML, NLP, GenAI, HPC/QC, Digital Twins, BIM/GIS, Robotics and other Industry 4.0/5.0 technologies.

Such a mix would allow the nuclear sector to be competitive with other sources of energy generation, and to make realistic the goal of tripling nuclear power, in global terms, necessary to achieve the Net Zero 2050 targets.

The uniqueness of the software is given by the combination of its holistic approach and its ability to follow the entire life cycle of the reactor thanks to architectural specificities, currently in the process of patenting, which can guarantee the complete VV&Q (verification, validation and quality certification) of AI systems, strictly necessary in the nuclear sector as well as for the defense sector. This makes the application usable in high-risk situations, ensuring complete abstraction and generalizability to any engineering of complex systems in highly regulated sectors such as aerospace, maritime and defense.

The product has an intrinsically innovative feature as it creates a new state of the art in the field of dismissal, design and management of nuclear reactors: these processes are currently managed completely by hand, especially for the regulatory field, thus involving a non-negligible amount of errors and delays often discriminating against the success or failure of an entire nuclear project.

CAELUS operates by means of Product Innovation (CAELUS Ecosystem), Process Innovation (Purpose-Specific AI/HW/Software Development and Qualification) and Technical Strategic Consultancy (Ancillary Services) plus operating Commercial Activities such as the Partners Program and the Qualification Program (making possible for companies in business like Aerospace and Defense to go towards the Nuclear market and vice versa by means of qualification, SW and services). Other Programs (Nuke4Africa, Nuke4Hydrogen, Nuke4Space, Coal2Nuclear, Nuke4Datacenters...) are on their way to be launched during the next year.

In this context,Space Technologies such as Satellites, Geospatial Data and Sensors are crucial to ensure efficiency, traceability and safety of the new nuclear sector, reason why we are interested in being inside ESA STAR and apply to multiple collaboration opportunities as they come available through the portal.

AIRWORKS doo is a newly founded business in Slovenia, to provide physical and digital technologies for applications where performance and safety are mission critical. The company, established in 2025 and 80% owned by AIRWORKS srl and its shareholders (all Italian based), aims to complement the mother company's existing portfolio by adding new solutions in the areas of both space products and digitization.
 
Mechanisms are the primary space industry segment. 
Here AIRWORKS doo intends to provide technologies that address a) unmet needs in the existing market, 2) missing products required by future missions, 3) replacement of non-European components for an EU self-reliant space sector.
 
Business development in the space segment is implemented along two parallel paths: direct collaborations (OHB Group, ArianeGroup, ISAR Aerospace, etc) and open competition within ESA programmes. Having not a background with ESA as space entity yet, it is worth explaining how AIRWORKS doo operates in regard to ESA regulations for geographical return. 
 
AIRWORKS doo is a design and research center in Nova Gorica (Slovenia) that executes its contracts in Slovenia independently from the nationality of its shareholders, particularly from point of view of man labour and project knowledge. The developments are entirely performed by its experienced CTO Mr. Matija Brumat, a team of four competent Slovenian engineers and a few carefully selected local suppliers. Mr. Brumat has considerable heritage in the mechanism segment, being lead mechanism engineer on several Coarse Pointing Mechanism programmes, in respect to design, engineering and MAIT. AIRWORKS doo team is also strengthened by Mr. Paul McMahon, retired senior specialist mechanism engineer and deputy head of the mechanisms group at Airbus Defence & Space UK. Mr. McMahon acts as an engineering mentor providing part-time, “on demand” consulting to the team and will not perform direct work on ESA or commercial projects due to the nature of its contract (zero hours, no obligations of minimum hours from sides)
 
Within the next 1-2 years AIRWORKS doo plans are to expand the staff to 12-15 FTE and implement a facility suitable for space equipment AIT activities.
 
The Italian shareholders play an active role in AIRWORKS doo exclusively in the corporate governance (goal setting, risk management, etc) and as business development accelerators (i.e. connecting AIRWORKS doo with Large Space Integrators to discuss opportunities).

GRID+ S.r.l. is an innovative startup founded within Sapienza University of Rome, combining scientific expertise and engineering capabilities to deliver advanced Artificial Intelligence solutions for enterprises and public administrations. The company operates across four main areas that reflect its integrated model.
Its consulting activities are based on a highly scientific and structured methodology that moves from preliminary analysis to prototyping and finally to the full integration of AI solutions within client systems. This approach ensures continuous support and covers a wide range of domains such as computer vision, time series forecasting, explainability of complex models, anomaly detection and large language models.
The company also develops proprietary products, with the AIaaS cloud platform at the core. This platform enables immediate access to services such as forecasting, anomaly detection, sentiment analysis and real-time recommendations, eliminating the need for hardware or dedicated staff. Alongside the platform, GRID+ has created advanced software for business process automation, multichannel communication management, content generation, decision support and customer interaction, with applications in sectors such as tourism, healthcare, marketing and entertainment.
Training represents another key asset, with programs designed for both managers and technical staff. Courses range from AI fundamentals to advanced topics such as Generative AI and the use of tools like Microsoft Copilot, and are always tailored to the vertical market of each client. Thanks to its strong link with academia, GRID+ ensures that its training activities are aligned with the latest scientific developments while remaining accessible to non-specialists.
Finally, research is central to GRID+’s identity. The company participates in Horizon Europe, ESA programmes and national R&D initiatives, while also collaborating with public and private organizations. A strategic scientific partnership with the Department of Information, Electronics and Telecommunications Engineering (DIET) at Sapienza University of Rome supports joint work on machine learning, deep learning, quantum computing and hyperdimensional computing, with applications in energy, healthcare, aerospace and urban systems.

Our History
Oxford Sigma is an internationally recognised advanced materials company focused on fusion, nuclear, and defence systems. Founded in 2019, we were established to support the commercial deployment of fusion energy by addressing the critical challenge of developing sustainable, high-performance materials for extreme environments.

Our Belief
We believe that the future of fusion energy, nuclear fission, and high-energy systems depends on materials that can withstand the harshest environments. By designing and validating these materials, we enable technologies that support energy security, national resilience, and climate action—always grounded in scientific integrity and engineering excellence.

Our Vision
Our vision is to accelerate the deployment of energy and defence systems that strengthen energy security and national resilience. We focus on enabling commercialisation through leadership in international standardisation, the development of advanced materials for extreme radiation and temperature conditions, and strategic innovation in materials engineering.

Our Approach
We pursue practical yet ambitious targets in materials selection and development for extreme environments—across fusion energy, advanced nuclear, and high-impact defence systems. Our approach is technology-agnostic and grounded in scientific rigor, engineering integrity, and pragmatic design. This enables us and our partners to make sound design choices, deliver advanced materials systems, and accelerate the de-risking of technology deployment.

As an ESA BIC incubatee we are developing the betterSoil Farm Assistant, a digital tool using earth observation data and agricultural and soil knowledge to create practical crop rotation recommendations for farmers as end users. The target group are companies and enterprises acting as food processors or manufacturers that have a network of farmers along their supply chain. The first version of the betterSoil Farm Assistant focuses on crop rotation recommendations for potato farmers in Germany/Europe.

InCirT, founded in 2022 as a spin-off from RWTH Aachen University, has developed a novel data converter technology that achieves up to 100 times wider modulation bandwidths (today 8 GHz instantaneous bandwidth with a single converter) and up to 10 times higher energy efficiency compared to current solutions. The technology enables coverage of wide frequency ranges — for example, from L-band to X-band — and serves as a key enabler for simultaneous multi-band functionality. This allows for a significantly simplified system architecture, substantially reducing chipset size and manufacturing costs.
Usually, the bottleneck in these systems lies in their core component — the data converter (ADC/DAC). Existing solutions are too slow, consume excessive power, and are too costly. At the same time, physical and technological limitations, particularly the end of Moore’s Law, mean that conventional approaches can hardly achieve significant further progress.

entityDescription: The Tplus Engineering GmbH is a provider of engineering services for project work as well as for R&D activities. The company was founded in 2014 as spin-off from the Institute of Aerospace Thermodynamics at the University of Stuttgart, Germany. Since then, the company has specialized in the numerical simulation of aero-thermal problems and related activties. Our core competences are in combined fluid dynamics and heat transfer problems, which are characterized by a strong interaction of the flow field with the temperature field. For the work, a wide spectrum of simulation approaches from 1D modeling to 3D CFD is used. The modeling includes implementation and model development work for 1D tools or CFD codes. Simulation activities cover the topics fluid mechanics (both incompressible and compressible), heat transfer and multiphase flows. In our tools, we rely on state-of-the-art simulation and modeling software with an independent selection of the appropriate tool from both commercial and open-source solutions. Apart from project-based work, the company develops solutions for optimization and automation, from optimization workflows using genetic algorithms to fully automated CFD processes with the capability to run 24/7 without user input. Our services are tailored but not limited to the industries from aviation and aerospace, power generation, automotive and turbomachinery.

description:
IMR’s vision is to enable manufacturing of all sectors and sizes to be leaders in the world of advanced manufacturing so that they can compete and thrive in the global economy. As a leading manufacturing Research & Technology Organisation (RTO) with labs and industrial pilot lines in Dublin and Mullingar, IMR works with leading global and indigenous brands to demystify and derisk new and emerging technologies & to deliver high-impact collaborative research. IMR’s ambition is to significantly accelerate the implementation of key elements of Ireland’s industrial strategy and enable Irish-based manufacturers to be early adopters and winners in the fourth industrial revolution. IMR will enable industry to capitalise on these opportunities and tackle the threats head-on, through a broad-based service offering to ensure industry has access to the latest technologies and knowledge in a timely fashion.
 
IMR’s comprehensive R&D program offers collaboration across the 4 thematic pillars: Digitisation, Robotics and Automation, Design for Manufacturing and Sustainable Manufacturing, to deliver solutions that enable industry to increase productivity, improve efficiency, upskill and build resilience, win new business and launch new products.
Since 2025, IMR is the Prime for ESA Phi-Lab Ireland - Europe's competence centre for next generation space optimised hardware.
entityDescription: IMR (Irish Manufacturing Research Ltd.) is an independent Manufacturing and Industrial Energy Efficiency Research & Technology Organisation (RTO) focused on delivering solutions to manufacturing. Our passion is to make Ireland a world leader in advanced manufacturing operations for both SME and indigenous export companies and for multinational corporations based throughout the island. In so doing, we want to ensure the continued competitiveness of Ireland’s manufacturing industry and its ability to grow (in terms of turnover, profitability and employment) through winning new business and investment. IMR is a significant conduit for Irish Industry into Europe and was selected as one of the successful candidates across Europe to become a Digital Innovation Hub in the area of Industry 4.0; Industrial IoT and Cyber-Physical Systems. This will position the centre as a one-stop-shop for manufacturing Industry to access information, expertise, funding and connectivity for advanced manufacturing technologies. In addition, the centre continues to be a main point of contact and information in Ireland for EU platforms and associations such as EFFRA, AVM-KIC, AM Platform, Manufuture, euRobotics, EARTO and others.
